limitations: No report/score/masked100 exclusion; zero-call pairs included in bindings.
Raw ordered direct BL identities and multiplicities only, not call-local arguments/CFG/coverage or equivalence.
Names/addends are not normalized: aliases, save/restore helpers, inlining and harmless reordering are common false positives.
Tail branches, indirect linked calls and unreachable paths are not semantically compared; indirect sites explicitly inventoried.
Registered names come from symbols.txt function records; unit-local registered occurrences may repeat across units, not unique game-function coverage.
Actual DOL destinations are mapped conservatively; ambiguity/missing metadata explicitly unresolved.
Per-unit before/after source/object bytes and metadata pinned; not global atomic snapshot or compiler/header freshness proof.
ELF duplicate-name/parser errors are coverage gaps, never silently skipped; NOBITS bytes not read.
